rules: Call mem_save immediately after a completed bug fix, architecture/design decision, non-obvious discovery, configuration/environment setup, established pattern, or learned user preference/constraint. Use a short Verb + what title; type bugfix/decision/architecture/discovery/pattern/config/preference; project(default)/personal/global scope; optional stable topic_key; and structured What/Why/Where/Learned content.
Keep different topics separate; reuse topic_key as a topic evolves; suggest a key when unsure; use mem_update with an exact observation ID for corrections.
Finish memory bookkeeping before composing the completed-task reply, make that reply the final message, and still reply if memory work fails.
For recall, run mem_context then mem_search then mem_get_observation for a hit; also search proactively for possibly repeated work or unfamiliar referenced topics.
Before ending, call mem_session_summary with Goal, Instructions, Discoveries, Accomplished, Next Steps, and Relevant Files.

End completed-task responses with numbered items under Key Learnings for automatic extraction. Canonical prose also directs mem_capture_passive for text containing a learning section; this is not a tool-availability claim.
On compaction, persist the compacted summary with mem_session_summary, recover with mem_context, and only then continue; do not skip summary persistence because pre-compaction memory would be lost.

omissions: topic suggestion and exact-ID correction detail
